# Maps and active route

```
BasicRouteDetail Map
  → ActiveRouteMap
      → loading pill
      → polyline + numbered pins
      → search waypoint
      → locate / zoom
      → tap stop → WaypointDetail / company
Company Navigate → MapChooserPopup (no capture)
Create * Map View → LassoMap (no capture)
```

See [Maps.md](../02-User-Interface/Maps.md).
